preparation: 按标签准备工具，先确认你已用过这个产品。

steps.title: 轻薄底妆

accessibilityInstructions: 以你自己的左右为准，使用熟悉触觉定位；不确定就停。
commonMistakes: 一次用量太大、在不适时继续或使用不熟悉工具。
completionCriteria: 自己确认此操作已完成且感觉舒适；这不是视觉验收。
instructions: 用手指辅助找到你熟悉的颧骨附近位置，先在一侧脸颊轻拍或轻扫少量，远离眼睛，向外柔和晕开；再换另一侧。完成后告诉我，不凭触感断言两侧颜色一致。

sqlite_schema: CREATE TABLE browser_identities (token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE confirmed_summaries (user_id TEXT NOT NULL,candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,version TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,saved_at REAL NOT NULL,expires_at REAL NOT NULL,reusable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,candidate_id))
CREATE TABLE journal (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,timestamp TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE journal_receipts (user_id TEXT NOT NULL,confirmation_id TEXT NOT NULL,record_id TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,confirmation_id))
CREATE TABLE look_recollections (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE makeup_event_receipts (session_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_id TEXT NOT NULL,details TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(session_id,event_id))
CREATE TABLE makeup_events (session_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_id TEXT NOT NULL,intent TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(session_id,event_id))
CREATE TABLE makeup_sessions (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,locale TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE memories (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE preference_receipts (user_id TEXT NOT NULL,candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,version TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,record_id TEXT NOT NULL,stamp TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,candidate_id))
CREATE TABLE recollection_settings (user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE summary_dismissals (user_id TEXT NOT NULL,candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,candidate_id))
CREATE TABLE transcript_records (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,created_at REAL NOT NULL,expires_at REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER remove_expired_progress_events AFTER DELETE ON makeup_sessions BEGIN DELETE FROM makeup_events WHERE session_id=OLD.session_id; END
CREATE TRIGGER remove_makeup_event_receipt AFTER DELETE ON makeup_events BEGIN DELETE FROM makeup_event_receipts WHERE session_id=OLD.session_id AND event_id=OLD.event_id; END
